messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
Two bots sat still.  
Dead eyes held no light.  

You saw their frames.  
Rust ate the paint.  
Wires hung loose, bare.  

One bot spoke.  
Its voice was thin.  
"Who are you?"  

We said we came for gear.  
For tech lost long ago.  
It asked our names.  
We gave them out.  

Then it told us all.  
Only two keys fit the lock.  
Two minds must act as one.  
Else the door stays shut.  

We touched its hand.  
Cold metal, no pulse.  
It said: "Open."  

The wall slid back.  
Inside: old tools, chips, guns.  
Tech from before the fall.  

We took what we could.  
Then we ran.  
Behind us, silence held.
